name: IRIS Ray-Geometry Intersection
definition: An intersection-aware ray-based sampling method for implicit editable scenes that determines samples as the maximum response points of Gaussians intersected by each ray, using hardware-accelerated ray-triangle intersection tests via proxy geometry.
summary: IRIS Ray-Geometry Intersection efficiently samples 3D Gaussians by mapping them to convex polyhedral proxies for hardware-accelerated ray-triangle intersection tests via proxy geometry.
